name: Franklin Antonio Hall

source.title: Franklin Antonio Hall emergency evacuation floor plans
source.publisher: UC San Diego Environment, Health & Safety / Jacobs School of Engineering
source.revision: 2025 public source catalog; no revision date is printed on the floor pages
source.scale: No architectural scale bar; page scales are approximately normalized using corresponding common-core walls.
notes: All four upper-ground floor pages reviewed from the downloaded original PDF.
The lower floor is also in the source (physical page 1), but is not imported in this supplement.
Two exact scheduled room labels, 1101 and 1450, have traced positions on Level 1.
1301 remains a source-listed Level 1 room without a position: the large northern auditorium is unnumbered in this PDF and is not assumed to be 1301.
All four previously browsable floors are retained with source-traced approximate silhouettes. Other rooms remain unmodeled.
The original Facilities layout is preserved unchanged. It had no room polygons and repeated the campus exterior footprint on every floor.

The campus exterior footprint has different southeast-wing angles from the floor diagrams, so a reliable uniform campus registration is not established. This supplement uses relative units and deliberately has no geo placement.
Floor alignment is approximate using matching common-core walls. Floor heights are illustrative. Small door recesses, external exit landings and columns are simplified.
